description: This file defines the TimesheetSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates filtering parameters such as date range and employee number for timesheet searches in the HR management system.

classes.name: TimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object that stores filtering parameters for timesheet searches, including date range and employee number, with a predefined sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field of 'timesheet.startDate'.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter parameter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter parameter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter parameter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.
